title: Smoother weapons
description: Smooths out all the weapons  like mace sword trident axe and bow
body: This texture pack enhances the look of all weapons by making them smoother, cleaner, and more visually appealing. Edges are refined, colors are slightly improved, and the overall design feels more modern while still staying true to Minecraft’s original style. Perfect for players who want a subtle upgrade without changing the core vanilla experience.
